regions.full_page: God bless you and yours. I have just read your favor of the 8th - pathetic enough in its way, though indicating nothing to be over anxious about. Good housekeepers and good busines-men are careful to have "a place for everything and everything in its place." In this they show a trace of the divine character of the universal Guide and Master, Who of course, has a place for each one of us. He, the Creator and Divine Governer of the universe in all its details, could create children as in the case of Adam and Eve without parents. He could teach little children without nuns or schools and give the holy sacraments as has been the case on several occasions, - without priests, therefore. In His divine economy, however, God has been pleased to honor His creatures- most especially His rationals - by giving them, each accord- ing to his ability, a part of His own work to do. Rather I ought to say, by participation and cooperation in His won divine activity, etc. Why be over anxious, therefore, about something that God himself is infinitely more solicitous than any of His creatures can be? If you go to the divine Headquarters by receiving holy Communion frequent- ly, and earnestly and humbly plead with the divine Spouse of our souls for guidance not only for yourself but particularly for each of those friends of whom you write - I am sure you will have nothing to be par- ticularly anxious concerning the important matter of your vocation. In the meantime of course we will be glad to include your inten- tions in our poor prayers.
